targets.old_statement: A 15-year-old learner's supervisor must be a parent, a guardian, a licensed driver at least 21 or a driving instructor, while the passenger limit for restricted drivers allows only 1 nonfamily passenger.
targets.old_spoken_statement: A fifteen-year-old learner's supervisor must be a parent, a guardian, a licensed driver at least twenty-one or a driving instructor, while the passenger limit for restricted drivers allows only one nonfamily passenger.
targets.statement: A fifteen-year-old learner must have a parent, legal guardian, licensed driver aged twenty-one or older, or licensed or certified driving instructor in the front seat next to the driver, whereas a restricted sixteen-year-old or seventeen-year-old licensed less than six months may carry at most one nonfamily passenger besides a parent, guardian, or supervising licensed driver twenty-one or older.
